t: Add conditional binary work offer to wakeup Step 7 — collapse briefing when work queue has ready items
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md — find Step 7 (Display Briefing) section. 2. Read WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/*/open/*.json to understand what 'ready' items look like (has description + PEV fields + not epic/signal). 3. Check if any items in the current lug store meet the 'Haiku-completable' threshold: <10 execute steps, has acceptance_criteria or verify field, no blockers.
execute: 1. Add 'Haiku-completable' definition to wai-lug-schema.md (or wai.md Step 7): ready = has PEV, steps <= 10, no blockers, type is task/bug/feature. 2. Add conditional logic to Step 7 in templates/commands/wai.md: if lugs/bytype/*/open/ contains >= 1 ready item, show simplified briefing: project identity (1 line), context health (1 line), queue summary ('Ready: N items | Backlog: M items'), binary offer ('[W]ork ready queue / [R]efine backlog / [S]kip?'). 3. If no ready items: fall back to current full briefing. 4. Sync wai.md to all targets: templates/spoke/skills/wai/, WAI-Spoke/commands/, WAI-Spoke/skills/wai/.
verify: 1. Read the modified Step 7 — conditional logic present. 2. With ready items in open/: wakeup shows 4-line briefing + binary offer. 3. With no ready items: wakeup shows full briefing (backward compat). 4. diff sync check across all targets.
acceptance_criteria: wai.md Step 7 has conditional logic: if open lugs with PEV exist, show simplified 4-line briefing + binary offer
Simplified briefing shows: project identity (1 line), context health (1 line), queue summary, work/refine/skip offer
If no ready items: full briefing displayed (backward compatible)
wai.md synced to all targets (templates/spoke/skills/wai/, WAI-Spoke/commands/, WAI-Spoke/skills/wai/)

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Add a conditional simplified wakeup briefing when work queue has ready items — presentation-layer change only
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not changing queue structure or lug schema — only how the briefing is displayed
